BATCH FIVE — A BRAIN DUMP, THEN TYPE
Mode: Experience. Code-led continuation explicitly pinned to original-site dense media and batch-four Live Poster / Outline. User asks another batch; twenty complete routes are the deliverable, not one direction to choose before building.

First viewport: CONTENT IMMEDIATELY. A dense bento or multi-image grid begins under a compact navigation bar, no wordmark, introduction, giant hero or sales copy. Several projects visible together at desktop; phone still opens into a dense grid. Actual videos play, muted inline and loop.
Navigation: Work, Archive, Index, Clients, Contact. Buttons only, no 3seater nav logo or visible pause-video control. Experiment with pills, square tabs, outlined buttons, segmented rails, side and bottom docks. Clear current-page state, visible underlined text links and contrasting hover/focus treatment.
Typography: self-hosted Anton retained as bold display voice. Self-hosted IBM Plex Mono is the chosen approximation for image2, not an identified exact match. Light monospaced labels, metadata and navigation pair with heavy index names. All case transformations preserve factual text.
Home structure: dense grid of 12–28 projects, a preview of 6–8 bold project rows and the original scroll-driven featured-client wheel. Vary wheel/list order and composition. Full Index route uses expressive bold titles with original-color moving thumbnail inserts at deterministic irregular positions (before, within, after words); some routes use alternating outlines. No random reordering or hidden project facts.
Original mechanisms: keep original featured-client exclusions and preferred ordering; wheel names open the corresponding real client project page. Preserve the original cylindrical scroll mechanism, reduced-motion fallback, accessible active client and static all-client directory on Clients.
Media: preview derivatives on cover grids and lists, original sources on project pages; natural aspect ratio on full detail media, no added black wrappers. All visible self-hosted video autoplays muted/loop. No hover prerequisite or deliberate offscreen pause. Original YouTube links embedded with privacy-enhanced URLs and direct links. Request muted looping autoplay on embeds; external providers and browsers can restrict it. No globally visible pause control per user instruction; native video controls available on detail.
Content: thirty real projects and fifty-one media, exactly the supplied facts and contact. All six YouTube source links retained, especially Iceman and Carti. Filterable Archive, bold full Index, client-specific galleries, Contact, individual project views and next-project links in all20.

20 compositions and navigation families are defined in directions.json and authored independently in layout CSS/markup. Every route opens on media, not a text-list or introduction. Keep historical batches unchanged for this request; create /batch-five/ and twenty numbered routes alongside them.
References: user-image1.png and user-image2.png under references are user-supplied screenshots, not generated assets. Original homepage src/app.js/style.css is behavior evidence; selected batch-four captures01/17 are visual authority for the list. User wants the two combined, with room to experiment.
